HAE LOE JUDAHNAWK IH SIANGPAHRANG, tiah Grik ca, Latin ca, Hebru ca hoiah a lu nuiah tarik pae o.
Thinglam pong takhing ih kami zae maeto mah, Nang loe Kri ah na oh nahaeloe, nangmah hoi nangmah to amhlong ah loe, kaihnik doeh pahlong khae, tiah hang thuih.
Toe kalah kami zae maeto mah loe anih to zoeh, Sithaw to na zii ai maw, nang loe anih hoi kangvan ah na ai maw danpaekhaih to na tongh?
Aihnik loe katoeng lokcaekhaih ni a hak hoi; a sak hoi ih hmuen baktih toengah ni tangqum to a hnuk hoi: toe hae kami loe zaehaih tidoeh sah ai, tiah a naa.
To pacoengah anih mah Jesu khaeah, Angraeng, siangpahrang ah na ukhaih prae ah phak naah kai na pahnet hmah, tiah a naa.

Jesu mah anih khaeah, \wj Loktang kang thuih, Vaihniah kai hoi nawnto paradise ah na om tih, \wj* tiah a naa.   
\s1 Jesu duekhaih  
\r (Mathai 27.45-56; Marka 15.33-41)
\x - \xo 23:44 \xt EXO 26.31-33.\x*Atue tarukto hoi kamtong takawtto karoek to long nui boih ah khoving.
Ni aengh anghmat moe, tempul pakaa ih kahni to hnetto ah angsih.
\x - \xo 23:46 \xt Saam 31.5.\x*Jesu loe tha hoiah hangh moe, \wj Pa, ka hinghaih Muithla na ban ah kang paek, \wj* tiah thuih: to tiah thuih pacoengah a hinghaih qui to apet.
Misatuh angraeng mah to tiah kaom hmuen to hnuk naah, Sithaw to pakoeh moe, Hae loe kami katoeng ni, tiah thuih.
To ahmuen ah nawnto kaom kaminawk boih mah, to tiah kaom hmuennawk to hnuk o naah, angmacae ih saoek to atumh o moe, amlaem o.

\x - \xo 23:49 \xt Luk 8.2,3.\x*Anih panoek kaminawk boih hoi a hnukbang Kalili prae ih nongpatanawk loe, ahmuen kangthla ah angdoet o moe, to ah kaom hmuennawk to khet o.   
\s1 Jesu aphum o  
\r (Mathai 27.57-61; Marka 15.42-47; Johan 19.38-42)
Khenah, Joseph, tiah ahmin kaom kami maeto oh, anih loe lok takroekkung maeto ah oh; anih loe kahoih kami, katoeng kami ah oh:
(Nihcae lok takroekhaih hoi a sak o ih hmuennawk to anih mah naakrah haih ai:) anih loe Judahnawk ih vangpui, Arimathea ah kaom kami, Sithaw ukhaih prae zing kami ah oh.
Qok to a lak moe, puu kahni hoiah ayaw pacoengah, mi doeh aphum vai ai ih, thlung hoiah thuk ih taprong thungah pasong.
To ni loe amprikcaihaih niah oh moe, Sabbath ni to anghnai boeh.
Kalili prae hoiah Jesu hnukbang nongpatanawk loe, Joseph hnukah bang o moe, anih ih qok kawbangmaw pasong o, tito khet hanah, taprong ah caeh o.
\x - \xo 23:56 \xt EXO 20.10; Deu 5.14.\x*To pacoengah im ah amlaem o moe, hmuihoihtuinawk to a sak o: toe nihcae loe kaalok baktih toengah Sabbath niah loe anghak o.

\s1 Jesu angthawk lethaih  
\r (Mathai 28.1-8; Marka 16.1-8; Johan 20.1-8)
Ni sarihto thung ih ni hmaloe koek, khawnthaw ah, nongpatanawk loe kalah nongpatanawk hoi nawnto, a sak o ih hmuihoihtuinawk to sin o moe, taprong ah caeh o.
Taprong ah a phak o naah kamlet ving tangqom kraenghaih thlung to a hnuk o.
Nihcae loe a thungah akun o, toe Angraeng Jesu ih qok to hnu o ai.
Nihcae dawnraihaih hoiah oh o nathuem ah, khenah, a aengh kampha kahni angkhuk kami hnetto nihcae taengah angdoet:
nihcae loe zit o moe, a mikhmai long ah akuep o, to naah nihnik mah nongpatanawk khaeah, Tikhoe kadueh kaminawk salakah kahing kami na pakrong o loe?

6-7 \x - \xo 24:6-7 \xt Mathai 16.21; 17.22,23; 20.18,19; Mark 8.31; 9.31; 10.33,34; Luk 9.22; 18.31-33.\x*Anih loe haeah om ai, angthawk boeh: Kami Capa loe kazae kaminawk ban ah paek o ueloe, thinglam pongah takhing o tih, toe ni thumto naah angthawk let tih, tiah Kalili prae ah a oh naah, ang thuih o ih lok to poek oh, tiah a naa.
To naah a thuih ih loknawk to nihcae mah panoek o let,
taprong hoiah amlaem o moe, toah kaom hmuen kawngnawk boih to kami hatlaito hoi kalah kaminawk khaeah a thuih pae o.
Toah kaom nongpatanawk thungah Meri Magdalene, Joanna, Jokob amno Meri hoi nihcae hoi nawnto kaom nongpatanawk athum o, nihcae mah patoeh ih kaminawk khaeah thuih pae o.
Toe nihcae mah thuih pae o ih loknawk to amsawn ah poek o pongah, nongpatanawk ih lok to nihcae mah tang pae o ai.

Piter loe angthawk moe, taprong ah cawnh; bih tathuk moe, khet naah, anih ayawhaih puu kahni khue to a hnuk, anih mah to tiah kaom hmuen to hnuk naah dawnrai moe, im ah amlaem.   
\s1 Emmu avang ah caehhaih
Khenah, to na niah nihcae thung ih kami long hnetto loe, Jerusalem hoiah meng sarihto kangthla, Emmau, tiah kawk ih avang ah caeh hoi.
A caeh hoi li naah toah kaom hmuen kawngnawk boih to a thuih hoi.
Nihnik mah thuih hoi moe, poek hoi li naah, Jesu angmah roe to angzoh moe, nihnik hoi nawnto a caeh.
Toe nihnik mah Anih to panoek hoi han ai ah nihnik ih mik to amtuengsak ai.
Anih mah nihnik khaeah, \wj Lam na caeh hoi naah tih lok maw na caep hoi moe, palung na set hoi? \wj* tiah a naa.
Kleopa, tiah ahmin kaom kami mah anih khaeah, Jerusalem ah angvin ah na oh to mah, vaihi thuem ah kaom hmuen kawng to na panoek ai maw? tiah a naa.
Anih mah nihnik khaeah, \wj Tih hmuen kawngnawk maw? \wj* tiah a naa. Nihnik mah anih khaeah, Nazareth Jesu kawng, anih loe Sithaw hoi kaminawk boih hmaa ah thacakhaih hoiah toksak moe, lok a thuih.
Kalen koek qaima hoi aicae ukkungnawk mah anih to hum hanah paek o, anih loe thinglam pongah takhing o.
Toe kaicae mah loe anih loe Israel kaminawk akrang kami ni, tiah oephaih ka tawnh o: hae tiah kaom hmuen loe vaihni hoiah loe ni thumto oh boeh.
Ue, khawnthaw ah taprong ah kacaeh, kaicae thung ih thoemto nongpatanawk mah doeh dawn ang rai o sak;
nihcae mah anih ih qok to hnu o ai, nihcae im ah amlaem o naah, Anih loe hing let boeh, tiah thuikung van kaminawk to ka hnuk o, tiah a thuih o.
Kaicae thung ih thoemto kaminawk to taprong ah caeh o, nongpatanawk mah thuih o ih baktih toengah kaom hmuen to a hnuk o: toe Anih to hnu o ai, tiah thuih pae hoi.
Anih mah nihnik khaeah, \wj Kamthunawk, Tahmaanawk mah thuih o ih loknawk boih tang hanah rai o parai: \wj*
\wj A lensawkhaih thungah akun hanah, Kri mah hae karai hmuennawk hae tongh mak ai maw? \wj* tiah a naa.
Mosi hoi kamtong tahmaanawk boih mah thuih ih, Cabu thungah kaom Anih kawng thuih koehhaih loknawk boih to nihnik khaeah a thuih pae.
A caeh hoi han ih avang phak hoi tom naah, Anih loe avang to poeng hanah a poek.
Toe nihnik mah, Kaihnik hoi nawnto om ah: niduem boeh, kho doeh ving boeh, tiah anih to kaang pae hoi. To pongah anih loe nihnik hoi nawnto oh hanah a caeh.
Anih buhcaak hanah nihnik hoi nawnto anghnut naah, takaw to a lak, oephaih lawkthuih moe, a aeh pacoengah, nihnik hanah a paek.
To naah a mik amtueng hoi moe, Anih to panoek hoi; anih loe nihnik khae hoiah anghmat pae ving.
Loklam ah anih mah cabu thung ih loknawk aihnik khaeah thuih naah, aihnik ih palung loe hmai mah kang ih baktiah oh roe na ai maw? tiah maeto hoi maeto thuih hoi.
Nihnik loe angthawk hoi moe, Jerusalem ah amlaem hoi, toah kami hatlaito hoi nawnto kaom kalah kaminawk to a hnuk hoi,
nihnik mah, Angraeng loe angthawk tangtang boeh, Simon khaeah amtueng pae, tiah a thuih hoi.

Nihnik mah loklam ah kaom hmuennawk, takaw a aeh naah Anih panoek hoi haih kawngnawk to nihcae khaeah thuih pae hoi.   
\s1 Kami hatonawk khaeah Jesu amtueng  
\r (Mathai 28.15-20; Marka 16.14-18; Johan 20.1-23; Toksahkungnawk 1.6-8)
To loknawk a thuih o li naah, Jesu angmah roe to nihcae salakah angdoet, nihcae khaeah, \wj Nangcae khaeah monghaih om nasoe, \wj* tiah a naa.
Toe nihcae mah angpae o, zit o moe, ka hnuk o ih loe pakhra mue, tiah a poek o.
Anih mah nihcae khaeah, \wj Tipongah na tasoeh o moe, palunghaenghaih na tawnh o loe? \wj*
\wj Ka ban hoi ka khok hae khen oh, kaimah boeh ni: na sui oh loe, khen oh; muithla loe ahuh hoi angan to om ai, toe nang hnuk o ih baktih toengah kai loe ahuh hoi angan ka tawnh, \wj* tiah a naa.
Hae tiah a thuih pacoengah, nihcae khaeah a ban hoi a khok to patuek pae.
Nihcae loe anghoehaih hoi dawnraihaih hoiah oh o, to tiah kaom hmuen to tang o ai. Jesu mah nihcae khaeah, \wj Caak koi buh na tawnh o maw? \wj* tiah a naa.
Nihcae mah anih hanah hmai pahaih ih tanga tetta hoi khoiphae maeto paek o.
Anih mah nihcae khaeah, \wj Nangcae hoi nawnto ka oh naah, Mosi ih kaalok, Tahmaanawk ih lok, Saam Cabu thungah tarik ih kai kawng loe akoep boih tih, tiah kang thuih o boeh to loe, \wj* tiah a naa.
Nihcae mah Cabu thung ih loknawk panoek o thai hanah, anih mah nihcae panoekhaih to paongh pae.
Nihcae khaeah, \wj Kri loe patangkhang ueloe, ni thumto naah angthawk let tih, tiah tarik ih oh: \wj*
\wj dawnpakhuemhaih hoi zae tahmenhaih kawng to Jerusalem hoiah amtong ueloe, acaeng kaminawk boih khaeah, anih ih ahmin hoiah taphong o tih. \wj*
\wj Nangcae loe hae hmuennawk hnukung ah na oh o. \wj*
